_comment: Suburb names as they appear in seed files, mapped to the canonical term
Why this has to exist. The importer derives a suburb's slug from its
name — sanitize_title('Perth') is 'perth' — so renaming a term on the
site silently breaks the next import: it finds no 'perth' term, creates
one, and the suburb is now split across two terms with the listings
divided between them. Nothing errors. You notice weeks later.

margaret-river: the CITY term owns that slug, so the town of the same name has to be margaret-river-town. Without this alias a seed saying suburb 'Margaret River' attaches the listing to the city itself.
